english: [TAB]There are tens of thousands of changelings living in Esus's hell, which can appear in any form and read their victim's minds to perfectly mimic the voice and mannerisms of those they copy. There they recreate any community or place that Esus desires to deceive those trying to escape hell into forfeiting hope and returning. Unlike most of the hell's denizens, Changelings are alive, not demons. [PARAGRAPH]Occasionally Changelings are sent into the mortal world of Erebus to perform tasks for Esus. They often sire children (most commonly by replacing a lover) with mortal women. english: The orthodox opinion of every religion or mage guild in Erebus holds that only rare individuals are blessed (or, in some cases, cursed) with affinity for any sort of magic. It is sacrilige to suggest that every mortal soul shares a natural gift in every precept, but this heresy happens to be true. While most men's affinities are too weak to be of much use, there are ways to awaken them. The architects of the Tower of Mastery go to great lengths to talk around this point rather than state it directly, but their ambition is let every mage match the powers of Kylorin.

english: Elven Pox is a disease that makes the victim magically inert, keeping them from being able to use magic. It is highly contagious, spreading through any contact with infected blood or saliva. It can quickly overtake an entire village if even one guard contracts it in combat. Certain breeds of wolves and trolls have adapted to being carriers of the disease, attacking once to infect a victims and then returning to finish off a whole settlement.

english: [ICON_BULLET]Cannot fall in an [LINK=SPELL_ARENA_BATTLE]Arena battle[\\LINK][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Being an Aspect of War is the highest blessing Camulos can grant, but he does not care who gets it so long as they use their power to kill. It is given at birth and cannot be revoked. All the Aspects have superhuman martial prowess, both in personal strength and in tactics. While they may not defeat whole armies on their own, in single combat are nearly invincible. Some are Good, some are Evil, and some are hostile towards both extremes, but they cannot remain neutral in any conflict for long. They are the cause of most wars, regardless of their intent. Notable Aspects of War include Arak the Erkling, Capria, Mahon the Butcher, Orthus, Magnadine, Surder, and Makhai. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Every god created seven Aspects, True Angels whose inherent affinity is exceeded only by that of the archangels or the gods themselves, and whose freedom to act in creation is not limited by The Compact. The original Aspects of War were vanquished early int he Godswar, but whenever one falls it is reincarnated as a mortal. Years can pass before an Aspect of War is reborn, but there are usually 5 to 7 active in the world at any time. The Sons of Discord try to track them individuals down and use them to cause more conflict.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]无法在 [LINK=SPELL_ARENA_BATTLE]竞技场战斗[\\LINK] 中倒下[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]身为战争化身是卡姆罗斯所能授予的最高赐福，但他毫不在意授予了谁，只要他们运用其力量去杀戮即可。它于出生时授予，且无法撤销。所有化身都拥有超人的武艺，无论个人力量还是战术皆然。虽然他们未必能凭一己之力击败整支军队，但在单打独斗中几乎无敌。有的向善，有的向恶，还有的对两个极端皆怀敌意，但他们无法在任何冲突中长久保持中立。无论其本意如何，他们都是大多数战争的根源。著名的战争化身包括厄尔王阿拉克、凯布瑞尔、屠夫玛洪、俄耳托斯、麦格纳丹、苏尔德和马卡伊。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]每位神祇都创造了七位化身，即真天使，其天生亲和仅次于大天使或诸神本身，且其在创世中行事的自由不受契约限制。最初的战争化身在诸神之战早期即被消灭，但每当一位倒下，他便转世为凡人。一位战争化身重生之前可能会过去数年，但世上通常同时有 5 至 7 位活跃。纷争之子设法追踪这些个体，并利用他们制造更多冲突。

[PARAGRAPH]The rage of the Orcs has summoned him from a realm of myths beyond the ether, where Bhall imprisoned the spirit of the Flame Lord once Godswar ended, back into the physical world. [PARAGRAPH]Madmen have begun to worship this beast, and others like him whom they hope to Stir from Slumber, in place of the gods. The priests of all religions warn that this Cult of the Dragon may soon become a scourge upon our land. [PARAGRAPH]Rumor has it that Acheron rests upon a bed of unrivaled riches. Multitudes covet The Dragon's Hoard, and hundreds have lost their lives seeking it. This is all in vain. Unlike most dragon species, Torch Dragons don't collect anything. The most valuable thing found in their lairs is their unquenchable mucus, which burns for days with enough heat to consume metal, stone, and even incorporeal spirits.

english: Recruits 6 Hill Giants to the player's cause.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Early explorers found it was best to avoid the massive giants that roamed the land. A bard, named Antonis of Oriel, wandered too close and was captured by a group called the Nilhorn. He offered the only gift he could for his life, he played a song. The wild giants were so entranced by his song that, when it ended, they sat unmoving and Antonis could have simply walked out of the makeshift camp they had dragged him back to. Fascinated by finding his new audience so appreciative, Antonis continued to play, and his performances became a part of the giants' nightly rituals.[PARAGRAPH:1]Antonis stayed with the Nilhorn for three years, until one of them reported seeing a Sheaim army approaching his homeland. The giants avoided any settled land and tried to convince Antonis not to return, but he left the giants and returned to defend Oriel. Although a talented musician, Antonis was an incompetent warrior and he was killed defending Oriel. When he fell, the Nilhorn came out of the forests and approached the besieged village. Both armies froze, unaccustomed to seeing giants willing to enter civilized lands. Searching the battlefield, the giants found Antonis's body, and, enraged, they set upon the Sheaim. The village defenders cheered at their new-found allies and joined in the assault.[PARAGRAPH:1]The battle was quick and the Sheaim were turned back. After it was over, the giants picked up the body of Antonis and carried it with them into the forests. The village raised a monument to their large rescuers and swore never to forget the aid they were given. The Sheaim never forgot the failed battle either, and forever avoided Oriel in their attacks.
chinese: 招募 6 名山丘巨人为玩家效力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]早期的探险者发现，最好避开那些在大地上游荡的庞大巨人。一位名叫奥里尔的安托尼斯的吟游诗人，因走得太近而被一群名为尼尔霍恩的巨人俘获。他为保命献上了他唯一能献之礼——他弹奏了一曲。这些野性的巨人被他的歌曲深深迷住，曲终之时，他们竟一动不动地坐着，安托尼斯本可径直走出他们把他拖回的那处临时营地。安托尼斯着迷于发现自己的新听众如此赏识，便继续弹奏，他的演出成了巨人们夜间仪式的一部分。[PARAGRAPH:1]安托尼斯与尼尔霍恩共处了三年，直到其中一名巨人报称看见一支塞安大军正逼近他的故乡。巨人们避开一切有人定居之地，试图劝阻安托尼斯不要返回，但他还是离开巨人，回去保卫奥里尔。安托尼斯虽是天才乐手，却是无能的战士，他在保卫奥里尔时阵亡。当他倒下，尼尔霍恩从森林中现身，逼近这座被围的村庄。两军皆僵住了，都不习惯看到巨人竟愿踏入文明之地。巨人们搜寻战场，找到了安托尼斯的遗体，勃然大怒，扑向塞安人。村庄守军为这些新得的盟友欢呼，加入了这场突袭。[PARAGRAPH:1]战斗迅速结束，塞安人被击退。事毕之后，巨人们拾起安托尼斯的遗体，带着它走入森林。村庄为他们高大的救星立起一座纪念碑，并起誓永不忘记所受的援助。塞安人也永远忘不了这场败仗，从此在进攻中永远避开奥里尔。

english: There have always been men that ran toward danger. In the age of Magic, some were known as the Brotherhood of Wardens. They were a secret organization that tried to protect the citizens of Patria from cruel edicts of the Imprimator Council. They rescued elven captives from the Duchy of Dust, chattel slaves from Candlefast, and debtors from the Duchy of Glimmerhome. [PARAGRAPH]The organization started as a secular one, but the archangel Pelian the Suffering was inspired by the brave members of the brotherhood. When the rebellions began and the war started between the Empyrean, the Sanctus Inquisition and the Imprimatur Council, the Brotherhood attempted to make sure that the weak and innocent weren't destroyed in that war. [PARAGRAPH]They had middling success. Many were lost. But if they could get those they rescued back to the Duchy of Logos, they would find the tides would turn in their favor. Enemies spells were weakened, rotting wolves would lose their scent, their own endurance, and hope returned. This was the arda of Sirona and the blessing she offered for their cause. "[PARAGRAPH:2]The Brotherhood of Wardens is a cult of Sirona that teaches men that they must do whatever they can to protect the least among them. The orthodox Wardens were exterminated in Calabim lands, but Alexis encourages the spread of a heretical sect that believes the best way to protect the meek is to teach them to passively accept any form of oppression without every trying to fight back. [PARAGRAPH:2]Pelian disobeyed Sirona during the Godswar. Sirona commanded that compassion required the defense of creation, but Pelian refused to be violent and abandoned her army. After suffering a massive defeat Sirona lay nearly destroyed. As the army of Aeron closed in, Pelian returned and placed a sanctuary around Sirona. Pelian was attacked, but he still refused to fight. Instead he was torn and tortured for 21 days and bore the worst of Aeron's torments. His body is forever broken from this ordeal. But after 21 days Sirona was revived and came out of the sanctuary to rescue her archangel and scatter the army of Aeron. The breaking of the compassionate Pelian was an example to the gods that the compact was needed. [PARAGRAPH]Pelian lay recovering for centuries. It wasn't until the Age of Ice that he gazed again into creation, drawn by the calls of those suffering. There was little he could directly do, but he whispered to the great Eurabatres, who was sleeping nearby and awoke the dragon, calling him to aid those in need. [PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Rebirth he attempted to calm the heart of Basium, before he marched through into hell. Pelian warned that his hubris would lead him into serving Agares, or at least remove his blessed protection from creation. But Basium ignored him and marched through the Throne of Hell. Pelian wept for him and those doomed to be lost with him. [PARAGRAPH]During the Age of Invention, when the Matronae came for the worshipers of the old gods, Pelian's spirit was with the few remaining worshipers of Sirona and called for them to be non-violent. He called for calm as they stood before the Shrine of Sirona, as their statues were torn down, as their holy texts were burned and as each worshiper of Sirona that refused to forsake their goddess was executed. Then he gathered their souls and carried them to the Isle of Birds. 自古以来，总有一些人会迎着危险而上。在魔法的时代，其中一些人被称为守护者兄弟会。他们是一个秘密组织，试图保护帕特里亚的公民免受钤印议会残酷法令之害。他们从尘埃公国救出精灵俘虏，从烛坚救出被视作牲口的奴隶，从微光家园公国救出负债者。[PARAGRAPH]该组织起初是世俗的，但大天使受难者裴利安为兄弟会中勇敢的成员所感召。当叛乱兴起、天空的教诲、圣裁审判所与钤印议会之间战端骤起时，兄弟会力图确保弱者与无辜者不在那场战争中被毁灭。[PARAGRAPH]他们的成效平平。许多人丧生。但只要他们能把所救之人送回罗格斯公国，局势便会转而对他们有利。敌人的法术被削弱，腐狼会失去嗅迹，他们自身的耐力与希望则得以恢复。这便是希柔娜的阿尔达，也是她为他们的事业所赐的福佑。“[PARAGRAPH:2]守护者兄弟会是希柔娜的一个教派，它教导世人必须竭尽所能去保护他们当中最弱小者。正统的守护者在卡拉比姆的土地上被灭绝，但艾莉柯西丝鼓励一个异端支派的传播，该支派认为保护软弱者的最佳方式，是教他们逆来顺受地接受任何形式的压迫，永不试图反抗。[PARAGRAPH:2]裴利安在诸神之战中违抗了希柔娜。希柔娜曾命令说，慈悲要求捍卫创世，但裴利安拒绝施暴，抛弃了她的军队。在遭受一场惨败后，希柔娜几近覆灭。当艾隆的大军逼近时，裴利安返回，在希柔娜周围布下一处庇护所。裴利安遭到攻击，但他仍拒绝还击。于是他被撕裂、被折磨了 21 天，承受了艾隆最残酷的酷刑。他的身躯因这场磨难而永远残破。但 21 天后，希柔娜复苏，走出庇护所救出她的大天使，击溃了艾隆的军队。慈悲的裴利安之破碎，向诸神昭示了契约之必要。[PARAGRAPH]裴利安休养了数个世纪。直到冰之时代，他才再度凝望创世，为受苦者的呼唤所牵引。他能直接做的甚少，但他向沉睡在附近的伟大的尤拉巴崔斯低语，唤醒了这头巨龙，召他去援助有难之人。[PARAGRAPH]在重生时代，他曾试图在巴希姆行军踏入地狱之前，抚平他的内心。裴利安警告说，他的狂妄将引他去为阿加雷斯效力，或至少会撤去创世对他的赐福庇护。但巴希姆无视了他，径直穿过地狱王座。裴利安为他，也为那些注定与他一同沦亡的人而恸哭。[PARAGRAPH]在创新时代，当母神会前来对付旧神的信徒时，裴利安的魂灵与希柔娜为数不多的余留信徒同在，呼吁他们保持非暴力。他呼唤他们在希柔娜圣殿前保持镇定——当他们的雕像被推倒、他们的圣典被焚毁、每一位拒绝背弃女神的希柔娜信徒被处决之时。随后他收拢他们的灵魂，将其带往飞鸟之岛。[PARAGRAPH:2]国教开放以下项目：[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=UNIT_TRISTAN]圆环之特里斯坦 When he obtained the Font of Life and rose again as the God Life, his nature was so changed that the Fellowship abandoned him and began worshiping his old archangel Cernunnos as their chief god. Sucellus himself actively intervened to create a new cult for himself, called the Unblemished. Many of its members were born through immaculate conception, or are the mothers of those so conceived, and manifest powerful affinity for Life. The Unblemished make the best healers in Erebus. They run hospitals that employ all the same treatments as the Grigori Medics while complimenting it with prayers from holy men who have been known to revive the dead by faith alone. The Stewards of Inequity are a cult to Mammon, although few of their members will ever realize this. Mammon prefers his follows believe that they serve only their own self interest. The Stewards hate any sort of honest work but will go to great lengths to amass fortunes. Most are already very wealthy and powerful men when they join this cult, although some are merely covetous and believe membership will help further their ambitions. Its ranks include many tax collectors, regulators, government lobbyists, almost every central banker, the upper management in most large companies, and even many priests high in the hierarchies of other faiths. Few Stewards rank high enough to ever learn of the existence of the cabal that convenes to decide the policies they all execute.
